query:
SELECT m.id, m.name, m.magicNumber, COUNT(p.id) as payment_count 
FROM magic_numbers m 
LEFT JOIN payments p ON m.id = p.magicNumberId 
WHERE m.name LIKE '%TEST%' OR m.magicNumber LIKE '%999%'
GROUP BY m.id, m.name, m.magicNumber;
